front: The {{c2::carpals}} are the {{c1::eight}} bones that form the wrist, and the {{c2::metacarpals}} are the {{c1::five}} bones that form the palm of the hand.
back_extra:
Distinguish: beyond the metacarpals come the phalanges, with two in the thumb (proximal and distal) and three in each of the other four digits.

Cue: wrist to fingertip runs carpals, then metacarpals, then phalanges.
